semantic_atoms.claim: The historical aicore tools/schranke predecessor is source-identified rather than hypothetical: wache-koenig.py is frozen with SHA-256 7e64dd0daa19aff5a6e560de9e542bc5460cb6d230048cd72fb806e5a3b42d23 alongside freigabe. contradiction_update.resolution_rule: Do not credit current runtime enforcement until exact host/global hook source, configuration and ordering bind the predecessor or a successor to the actual tool execution boundary.

triggerword4_contract: Use typed owner capability grants bound to invocation/request/resource/generation and expiry; salvage command-binding/hard-deny invariants, not predecessor regex/typing heuristics.
Assembly acceptance must inspect plugin-local and host/global hook layers; unproven external wiring receives zero enforcement credit.
One deterministic EffectGate must be visible in the executor call graph and demonstrably prevent a denied Write/Edit before execution.
next_exact_gate: Acquire current host/global Claude hook configuration or exact wache-koenig deployment source and prove ordering relative to Claude Write/Edit execution; absent that, Triggerword-4 must treat the historical gate as donor-only and implement/test a deterministic successor.
